_comment: Source/claim ledger. One row per factual claim used on the site (RTP, provider identity, max win, legal/regulator status, tax treatment, operator availability, helpline). Fill from primary or authoritative sources. 'Unknown stays unknown' - never invent to fill a row. This backs the EEAT/sourcing of the site.

claims.claim: e.g. declared RTP is up to 98%
claims.limitation: e.g. declared, operator-dependent, long-run average not a guarantee
claims.reuse_rights: e.g. attributed fact, no asset reuse

unknowns: List facts you could NOT verify. These must be presented as unknown on the site, never invented.
